Choose Google, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or ChatGPT from the right selector. Tap the active app icon on the left to choose that app’s mode. Tap the center once to edit or run the selected mode; double-tap the center to open the selected app normally.
No root, overlay, accessibility, or system modification.

Choose Google, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, or ChatGPT from the right selector. Tap the active app icon on the left to choose that app’s mode. Tap the center once to edit or run the selected mode; double-tap the center to open the selected app normally.
This launcher uses manual widget placement. Tap below, then long-press an empty home-screen area → Widgets → search “Widget Bar” → drag it into place.
Long-press an empty home-screen area → Widgets → search “Widget Bar” → drag it onto the home screen.
Switchable search/create bar with per-app modes
